name: Microwave oven production line solution
summary: A full-line automation solution for microwave oven manufacturers, covering cavity assembly, door installation, electrical wiring, and final testing and packaging.
contentHtml:
The microwave oven production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for microwave oven manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including cavity forming, magnetron installation, waveguide installation, door installation, electrical wiring, panel installation, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Automated cavity forming with high dimensional accuracy
  • Precise magnetron installation ensures microwave performance
  • Automated door installation ensures consistent sealing effect
  • Standardized electrical wiring ensures high wiring reliability
  • Fast multi-model changeover ensures high capacity utilization
  • High degree of full-line automation ensures high production efficiency

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and debugging to after-sales service.
